zh.title: PDF Blender 隐私政策
zh.intro: 本政策说明 BITCOOKIES 的 PDF Blender 桌面应用及其产品网站如何处理信息。如有隐私问题，请通过 [GitHub 问题反馈](https://github.com/bitcookies/pdf-blender/issues) 联系我们。

sections.title: 1. PDF 文件处理
paragraphs: PDF Blender 在您的设备上预览和处理您主动选择或拖入的 PDF。应用不会将 PDF 文件或正文上传到 BITCOOKIES 的服务器或第三方处理服务，核心 PDF 功能无需联网。处理结果作为新文件保存在原文件旁，不覆盖原始 PDF。
处理过程中可能在输出目录创建临时文件。应用会在正常完成、失败或取消时尝试清理；断电、强制终止或文件访问错误可能留下临时文件。请自行保管并删除不再需要的原文件和处理结果。

sections.title: 2. 本地设置与配置
paragraphs: 应用在本机保存主题、语言、配置和槽位等设置。配置可能包含您主动填写的名称、水印文字、自定义复制警示、提示词，以及作者、组织和版权声明。这些信息用于恢复设置和执行您选择的功能，不会作为应用遥测发送给 BITCOOKIES。当前应用不会将导入 PDF 的正文或文件历史保存到配置文件中。
您可以在应用中删除配置，或通过设置页提供的本地配置位置管理保存的数据。Windows 可能重定向 MSIX 应用的数据位置；卸载行为也可能因系统或备份设置而不同。

sections.title: 3. 输出文件中的信息
paragraphs: 当您开启水印、元数据、版权声明或隐藏文字功能时，相应文字会写入生成的 PDF。文件接收者、PDF 阅读器或文字提取工具可能读取这些信息，包括正常视图下不可见的文字。请勿在这些字段中填写不希望随输出文件分享的信息。

sections.title: 4. 设备功能与通知
paragraphs: PDF Blender 不使用摄像头、麦克风、位置服务或联系人。应用读取 Windows 主题偏好以支持跟随系统主题。开启 Windows 通知后，完成通知可能在屏幕上显示输出文件名；此选项默认关闭。
安装时显示的“使用全部系统资源”表示应用采用普通 Windows 桌面运行方式。应用按当前用户权限运行，不请求管理员权限；这一提示不表示应用正在使用上述设备功能。

sections.title: 5. 应用联网、外部服务与更新
paragraphs: 当前桌面应用不包含广告、使用分析或文档上传服务。您主动点击 GitHub 或 Microsoft Store 链接时，会打开对应外部服务，它们按各自的隐私政策处理访问。应用不会向这些链接附加 PDF 内容。Microsoft Store 的安装和更新由 Microsoft 提供，其信息处理受 Microsoft 的政策约束。

sections.title: 6. 产品网站
paragraphs: 产品网站由 Vercel 托管。访问网站时，Vercel 及其交付基础设施可能为提供页面、保障安全和排查故障处理 IP 地址、请求路径、访问时间和浏览器相关技术信息。这些网站访问数据不同于桌面应用中的 PDF 内容；网站不提供 PDF 上传或在线处理功能。
本网站不设置广告或行为分析工具。浏览器在本地保存您选择的主题和语言，用于下次访问时恢复界面。托管服务的信息处理详情请参阅 [Vercel 隐私政策](https://vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy)。本政策不承诺我们无法核实的托管日志保留期限。

sections.title: 7. 联系与问题反馈
paragraphs: 如果您提交 GitHub 问题，我们会接收您主动提供的信息，并用来回复、排查问题和提供支持。GitHub 也可能处理这些信息。GitHub 的公开问题可能被其他人查看；请不要提交密码、敏感 PDF 或不必要的个人信息。支持通信会根据解决问题及适用要求所需的时间保留，隐私相关请求可通过上述 GitHub 问题反馈链接提出。

sections.title: 8. 政策更新
paragraphs: 如果信息处理方式发生变化，我们会更新本页面及生效日期。您可通过 GitHub 问题反馈咨询本政策或提出与我们持有的信息有关的请求；适用权利及处理要求以相关法律为准。

en.title: PDF Blender Privacy Policy
en.intro: This policy describes how BITCOOKIES' PDF Blender desktop app and product website handle information. For privacy questions, contact us through [GitHub issues](https://github.com/bitcookies/pdf-blender/issues).

sections.title: 1. PDF processing
paragraphs: PDF Blender previews and processes PDFs that you select or drop into the app on your device. It does not upload PDF files or their contents to BITCOOKIES' servers or a third-party processing service. Core PDF tools work offline. Results are saved as new files beside the originals without overwriting them.

Processing may create temporary files in the output folder. The app attempts cleanup after completion, errors or cancellation. A power loss, forced termination or file-access error may leave temporary files. You are responsible for managing originals and output files that you keep.

sections.title: 2. Local settings and configs
paragraphs: The app stores preferences, configs and slot assignments on your device. Configs may contain names, watermark text, custom copy warnings, prompts, and author, organization or copyright details that you enter. They are used to restore your settings and run selected tools, not sent to BITCOOKIES as app telemetry. The current app does not store imported PDF contents or file history in its config files.

You can delete configs in the app or manage stored data using the local config location available from Settings. Windows may redirect packaged-app data locations, and uninstall behavior may depend on system or backup settings.

sections.title: 3. Information embedded in output files
paragraphs: If enabled, watermarks, metadata, copyright notices and hidden text are embedded in output PDFs. Recipients, readers and extraction tools may read this information, including text that is invisible in normal viewing. Do not enter information that you do not want to share with the output file.

sections.title: 4. Device features and notifications
paragraphs: PDF Blender does not use your camera, microphone, location or contacts. It reads Windows theme preferences to support the system theme. Optional Windows notifications may display output file names; they are switched off by default.

The installation message “Uses all system resources” describes the app's desktop execution model. The app runs with your current user permissions and does not request administrator access. The message does not mean the app uses the device features listed above.

sections.title: 5. App networking, external services and updates
paragraphs: The current desktop app includes no advertising, usage analytics or document-upload service. GitHub and Microsoft Store links open those services when you choose them. They handle visits under their own policies; the app does not attach PDF contents to those links. Microsoft supplies Store installation and updates under its own policies.

sections.title: 6. Product website
paragraphs: The website is hosted by Vercel. When you visit, Vercel and its delivery infrastructure may process IP addresses, request paths, timestamps and browser-related technical information to deliver pages, maintain security and troubleshoot issues. Website requests are separate from PDFs processed by the desktop app. The website has no PDF upload or online processing feature.

The website uses no advertising or behavioral analytics tools. Your browser stores your selected theme and language locally to restore the interface on a later visit. See [Vercel's Privacy Policy](https://vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy) for hosting-related information. We do not state a hosting-log retention period that we have not verified.

sections.title: 7. Support communications
paragraphs: When you open a GitHub issue, we receive the information you choose to provide and use it to respond, troubleshoot and offer support. GitHub may also process it. Public GitHub issues can be viewed by others; do not post passwords, sensitive PDFs or unnecessary personal information. Support communications are retained as needed to resolve requests and meet applicable requirements. Send privacy requests through the GitHub issues link above.

sections.title: 8. Policy changes
paragraphs: If information handling changes, we will update this page and its effective date. Contact us through GitHub issues with policy questions or requests concerning information we hold. Applicable rights and response requirements depend on relevant law.
